txt_en: Wisdom is oftentimes nearer when we stoop than when we soar.
txt_cn: 比起高飞的时候，智慧往往在我们俯身时更接近我们。
author: William Wordsworth

txt_en: Trees are poems that the earth writes upon the sky.
txt_cn: 绿树是大地谱于苍宇的诗篇。
author: Kahlil Gibran

txt_en: Find a place inside where there's joy, and the joy will burn out the pain.
txt_cn: 在内心找一个欢乐的角落，这欢乐可让痛苦烟消云散。
author: Joseph Campbell

txt_en: A happy marriage is the union of two good forgivers.
txt_cn: 两个善解人意的人才能缔造一段幸福的婚姻。
author: Ruth Graham

txt_en: The future has several names. For the weak, it is the impossible. For the fainthearted, it is the unknown. For the thoughtful and valiant, it is the ideal.
txt_cn: 未来有几个名字：对软弱的人来说，它叫不可能；对胆怯懦弱的人来说，它叫未知；对于深思熟虑且有勇气的人来说，它叫理想。
author: Victor Hugo

txt_en: Character may be manifested in the great moments, but it is made in the small ones.
txt_cn: 品格彰显于重要时刻，却培养于日常琐事中。
author: Phillips Brooks

txt_en: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
txt_cn: 前进的秘诀是着手开始。
author: Mark Twain

txt_en: Defeat is not the worst of failures. Not to have tried is the true failure.
txt_cn: 被击倒不是最大的失败，不曾尝试过才是真正的失败。
author: George E. Woodberry

txt_en: Believe and act as if it were impossible to fail.
author: Charles F. Kettering

txt_en: Friends and good manners will carry you where money won't go.
txt_cn: 朋友和教养带给你的世界，是金钱所不能及的。
author: Margaret Walker

txt_en: Love is like quicksilver in the hand. Leave the fingers open and it stays. Clutch it and it darts away.
txt_cn: 爱情就如手中的水银。张开手指，它就留在手中；一旦攥紧，它就飞快离开。
author: Dorothy Parker

txt_en: There is a pleasure in the pathless woods; there is a rapture on the lonely shore.
txt_cn: 无径之林，常有乐趣；无人之岸，几多欢喜。
author: Lord Byron

txt_en: If you would be loved, love, and be loveable.
txt_cn: 如果你想要被爱，就要去爱，并要让自己值得被爱。
author: Benjamin Franklin

txt_en: Winners lose more than losers, because they stay in the game.
txt_cn: 胜利者比失败者输得场次更多，因为他们一直留在赛场上。
author: Terry Paulson

txt_en: Obstacles cannot crush me. Every obstacle yields to stern resolve.
txt_cn: 障碍压垮不了我，在我坚定的决心面前，一切障碍都会让步。
author: Leonardo da Vinci

txt_en: If you saturate your mind with positive thoughts, it will sustain you in any situation.
txt_cn: 让大脑装满积极的想法，能支撑你度过任何境遇。
author: Lailah Gifty Akita

txt_en: No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world.
txt_cn: 不论别人怎么说，言语和想法能改变世界。
author: Robin Williams

txt_en: One loves the sunset when one is so sad.
txt_cn: 当一个人情绪低落的时候，他会格外喜欢看日落。
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

txt_en: Progress is the activity of today and the assurance of tomorrow.
txt_cn: 进步是今天的动力、明日的保证。
author: Emerson
